messages:
Maya L: Ugh — cat took out my monitor arm and now my second display is hanging at a weird angle. send duct tape and good vibes :sob:
Chris P: hahaha oh no. duct tape, zip ties, and a firm talk with the cat. also +1 for a weighted monitor stand.
Sanjay R: my setup pro tip: IKEA shelf + VESA mount = indestructible(ish). saved my life when my toddler tried to 'help' me.
Olivia: Posting my corner of the world: two plants, blackout curtains, and a cheap ring light that actually does the job. will post pic in thread later. :seedling:
Maya L: pic incoming (too embarrassed). desk is a mess but lighting is surprisingly good.
Chris P: remote wifi PSA — had a 20 min outage this morning. ISP sent this lovely message: "scheduled maintenance" at 7:15am. no heads up. :rage:
Sanjay R: same, my router flapped during a deploy window. quick fix was a router reboot and switching to my phone hotspot for the tail-end of tests.
Olivia: for anyone hit by flaky home wifi, this tiny set of steps helps:
```
1) power-cycle modem + router (unplug 30s)
2) move router to higher spot / away from microwave
3) set 5GHz SSID and connect devices that need bandwidth
```
Maya L: bookmarking that. also, is anyone else running into Zoom audio lag? Thinking of switching to wired for meetings.
Chris P: wired is night and day. ethernet cable + adapter for MacBook = instant sanity.
ops-bot: network-monitor: Detected 2 brief drops from ISP "HomeFiber" in zipcode 94107 between 07:10-07:20 UTC. No incident declared.
Sanjay R: ops-bot saving lives. :pray:
Olivia: random poll — post a pic of your desk or react with :thumbsup: if you prefer not to. I'll make a collage.
Maya L: :thumbsup: (no pic, dignity intact)
Chris P: uploading one with a very guilty plant on the edge.
Sanjay R: uploaded. warning: glorious cable spaghetti.
Olivia: love these. will assemble and drop in #all-hands tomorrow for the mini-contest :trophy:
Maya L: please no judging my 4-monitor circus. :sweat_smile:
Chris P: judge gently. :heart:
Olivia: gif battle later? winner gets name on a virtual sticky note.
Maya L: i'm in.
